answer_1.quote: In this work, we study open-ended text generation, in which a token sequence, x = {x 1 , . . . , x m }, is provided as context to a language model and the task is to generate a continuation, x = {x 1 , . . . , xc }, from the model's probability distribution, p θ (x), where θ denotes the model's parameters
answer_1.outputs: continuation sequences generated from context prompts

answer_2.quote: We assess language model performance in terms of perplexity and accuracy... Diversity (D) takes into account the sequence-level repetition at different n-gram levels of a document... Self-BLEU evaluates the BLEU score of each document compared to all other documents in the generation set... MAUVE measures the distribution similarity between the original human text and the generated text... Readability is evaluated using the Flesch-Kincaid Reading-Ease score
